title: Providing Furnishing items to Inspection Quarter & Transit Accommodation at Diamond Harbour FFM Station, West Bengal.
summary: E-tender (two-bid) for providing furnishing items to the Inspection Quarter and transit accommodation at the Diamond Harbour Far Field Monitoring (FFM) Station, West Bengal (Kolkata Directorate).

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata

sites.name: Diamond Harbour FFM Station, West Bengal
sites.work: Furnishing items for Inspection Quarter and transit accommodation

scope.item: Providing Furnishing items to Inspection Quarter & Transit Accommodation

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR/Bank Guarantee of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata, payable at Kolkata; valid three months from technical bid opening; exemption not allowed; original EMD to reach office by 06.10.2025 15:00.

period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration of appropriate class in appropriate category (building civil/interior decoration work) with Central Govt department/undertaking/autonomous body or State Govt
Similar works in last 7 years: three each >= 40%, two each >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost; client certificates; value updated at 7% simple per annum
Similar works: furnishing and interior decoration works
Valid PAN card and GST registration
Notarized affidavit (2025) of not blacklisted/debarred; undertaking that price bid is unconditional
Signed Tender Acceptance Letter; other documents per Section VI
notes: Section I NIT only (printed pages 3-6); no BOQ or list of furnishing items. Location field in NIT reads 'Deep Bhavan, Kolkata, West Bengal' although the work is at Diamond Harbour FFM Station. Bid document download 15.09.2025 18:00 to 06.10.2025 15:00; technical bid opening 07.10.2025 16:00. Bidders asked to visit site before quoting. CPPP digital signature stamp dated 15.09.2025 (signer name not transcribed).
